items.title: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
items.summary: Berkshire owned about 106 million shares in the parent of Google, worth $37.9 billion at the end of June, according to a regulatory filing released Friday.

items.title: Goldman’s latest cash cow is all about funding the AI infrastructure boom
items.summary: Nvidia and Intel recently tapped the bank to help them meeting soaring demand for compute.

items.title: Regulators and banks step up scrutiny of prediction markets
items.summary: The CFTC is reviewing prediction betting platforms' so-called mention markets, people familiar with the matter confirmed to CNBC.

items.title: ACBS: Doanh nghiệp liên quan Vinhomes phát hành hơn 2 tỷ USD trái phiếu trong một quý
items.summary: Theo dữ liệu của ACBS, các doanh nghiệp liên quan Vinhomes đã phát hành 57.000 tỷ đồng trái phiếu, tương đương 2,1 tỷ USD trong quý II.

items.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
items.summary: Relay, which offered businesses workflow automation, will stop operating next month. Its CEO and some of its staff plan to get to work on Google Chrome next.

items.title: OpenAI CFO Friar tells investors that enterprise business now bigger than consumer by revenue
items.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar met with investors following a week of turmoil in the C-suite that included the sudden departure of revenue chief Denise Dresser.

items.title: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
items.summary: OpenAI's C-suite turnover gives investors another reason for concern as the company pushes toward a mammoth IPO.

items.title: Drone stocks rally after Trump orders tariffs on foreign-made components
items.summary: The U.S. is looking to scale defense manufacturing and chip away at China's drone dominance.

items.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
items.summary: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file.

items.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
items.summary: The idea that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows may be a misconception, according to French startup Kog.
